title: Belonging is not a private possession
summary: This meets the self that keeps guarding worth like scarce property. The line widens the heart by saying all belong to the One, and the One belongs to all.
takeaway: Receive belonging instead of hoarding it.
lifeApplication: When you start measuring your place in the room, loosen the chest and hear the line once. Let shared belonging interrupt the need to rank yourself.

source.shortMeaning: Belonging is received from the One who holds everyone together.
source.lifeApplication: When worth feels scarce, remember that belonging is not yours to ration.
